about: Links to a route by the ID a manifest declares. RouteLink resolves the ID through the route map at render time, so a link keeps working when the route's path changes.
after: to see every axis it offers.

inline.about: A link inside a sentence. useRouteHref resolves the route ID to its path, and createLink(Link) links to the path with the navigation package's link ink and underline.
inline.title: In a sentence

resolving.about: One link per route ID, each resolved through the router's route map. Following a link opens the page at its current path.
resolving.title: Resolving an ID

title: Route link
